name: Wolf Gold

features.name: Money respins
features.description: 6+ moon symbols trigger 3 respins where only moons land and the counter resets on each new moon.

features.name: Fixed jackpots
features.description: Mini, Major and Mega fixed jackpots are available through the respin feature.

features.name: Giant symbols
features.description: Stacked giant symbols can cover the middle reels in free spins.

review:
A long-running, medium-volatility hold-and-win classic. It's not as spectacular as modern tumble games, but it's much gentler on a balance: wins come more often and the moon respin feature triggers regularly.

Moons stick during respins, giant symbols can fill the middle reels, and fixed jackpots give it something to chase. 2,500x max, 96.01% RTP. A good pick for classic five-reel play with a jackpot element.
author: editorial-team
